summary: This bill directs the Secretary of the Army to establish a 6-year program to research and develop stabilization and erosion control technologies, including biomimetic methods and alternatives to hardened structures, to prevent coastal erosion in diverse geographic locations.

scores.thoughts: The bill establishes a new program for research and development related to coastal stabilization and erosion control technology, explicitly stating it is 'subject to the availability of appropriations.' This indicates a new area of government spending, even if the specific amount is not defined in the bill.

The bill authorizes a new 6-year federal research, development, and testing program for coastal erosion control technologies, to be carried out subject to appropriations. It contains no revenue raisers, spending offsets, or deficit-reduction measures, so any resulting outlays would increase the deficit to fund this priority.
